units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:3">Snh. III, 3</cite> (among those disqualified as witnesses) <he>המשחק בק׳</he> the habitual dice-player; <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:8">R. Hash. I, 8</cite>; Y. ib. 57ᶜ top <he>בקוּבְיָיא</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 23:2">Sabb. XXIII, 2</cite> <he>משום ק׳</he> (omitted in Bab. ed. 148ᵇ) it is forbidden, because it is like gambling; ib. 149ᵃ; a. e.
